findings.title: Refresh cached request-parent state
findings.body: Consider only; does not fail check 24. When an outstanding parent RPC completes, Interaction::content emits a new scope_parent_state, but AgentView::sync_interactions treats a hit on state/selected_work_id/delivery/application/selection as immutable and does not copy scope_parent_state. The field is not rendered and is not consulted by pending() or admission, so the human still sees the official scope and cannot submit a rebound answer. Copy that key with the other mutable canonical fields if a later surface displays it.

findings.title: Keep boolean unset distinct on first Space
findings.body: Consider only; does not fail check 11. Space on an unset boolean uses unwrap_or(false) and therefore stores true. Unset remains None until that press, and a second Space reaches false, so false, zero, and empty are not collapsed into omission and F4 can unset again. A first Space that leaves the field unset, or that sets false when the current value is absent, would make the one-press path match the unset/false distinction already used for text.
